# Imran Sarker

> Imran Sarker is a performance marketer and web developer from Bangladesh, and the Founder & CEO of Humble IT Solution. He helps e-commerce and dropshipping brands in the USA, Portugal, Dubai and Bangladesh grow with Facebook, Instagram, Google and TikTok Ads, accurate conversion tracking, and high-converting websites.

## Key facts
- Role: Performance Marketer & Web Developer; Founder & CEO, Humble IT Solution (12-person in-house team)
- Experience: 4+ years
- Ad spend managed: $513K+ total ($375K+ Google Ads, $138K+ Meta / Facebook & Instagram Ads)
- Brands served: 90+ (clients in the USA, Portugal, Dubai/UAE and Bangladesh)
- Campaigns: 1,200+
- Works remotely with clients worldwide (GMT+6), fluent in English and Bengali
- Certification: Google Ads Display Certification (Google Skillshop), issued June 2026, valid until June 2027, ID 185942324

## Case study
- Education & immigration consultancy (Bangladesh, multi-branch), Meta Ads lead generation managed since 2023: 573 campaigns, 66,140+ messaging conversations at about $0.20 each, 7.99M people reached, 43.2M impressions, $14,854 total spend.
- E-commerce sales campaigns (Meta, 2026): 1,480+ website purchases at $0.86 average cost per purchase (best $0.28) on $2–$5 daily budgets.
- Online store at scale (Meta, 2026): 2,819 website purchases at $2.85 average cost per purchase across 11 campaigns, $8,042 spend.
- New store launch (Meta, Aug 2026): 95 purchases at $0.83 average cost per purchase on $2/day campaigns.

## Services
- Facebook & Instagram Ads (Meta Ads): strategy, creative testing, retargeting, scaling
- Google Ads: Search, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube
- TikTok Ads: Spark Ads, UGC creatives, product testing for dropshipping
- Conversion tracking: Meta Pixel, Conversion API (CAPI), server-side GTM, GA4, Google Tag Manager
- E-commerce websites and landing pages: WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Laravel

## Good fit for
- E-commerce and dropshipping brands that want profitable, scalable paid ads
- Businesses with broken or inaccurate tracking after iOS updates
- Brands that need ads, landing pages and tracking handled by one accountable team
